name: xpanel
description: A local-first Manifest V3 API client inside Chrome DevTools.

scripts.build: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @xpanel/extension build && pnpm --filter @xpanel/relay-cloudflare build
scripts.assets:store: pnpm assets:brand && pnpm build:extension && node scripts/e2e-chromium.mjs --store-assets
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm --filter @xpanel/relay-cloudflare types:check && pnpm build && pnpm audit:static && pnpm assets:verify
scripts.release:prepare: pnpm check && pnpm e2e:chromium && pnpm --filter @xpanel/extension zip && node scripts/prepare-release.mjs
